## react-big-schedule 8.0.0

**From 8.0.0 on, only the latest release (8.0.0 or later) is supported.** Issues and security fixes for older versions will not be handled; please upgrade first.

### Breaking changes
- Removed the deprecated `besidesWidth` config and `SchedulerData.setBesidesWidth()`. The scheduler measures its own container, so just remove the option.
- The locale is now kept per `SchedulerData` instance instead of on the global dayjs singleton (#146). `schedulerData.setSchedulerLocale(...)` / `schedulerData.localeDayjs.locale(...)` no longer change other schedulers or your app's own dayjs. If you relied on that global side effect, call `dayjs.locale(...)` yourself.
- Vertical resource view events can now be moved and resized (`config.movable` / `startResizable` / `endResizable`, same as the horizontal views). Set them to `false`, or leave out `moveEvent` / `updateEventStart` / `updateEventEnd`, to keep the view read-only.

### New
- Vertical resource view: drag an event to another resource and/or time row to move it, and drag its top or bottom edge to resize it.
- Drop preview: a box shows where a dragged event, task or resource would be placed. Configure it with `dropPreviewEnabled`, `dropPreviewClassName` and `dropPreviewStyle`.
- Month and week-number header rows: `showMonthRow` / `monthRowHeight`, with the existing `showWeekNumber` (#148).
- Weekly, monthly and quarterly columns for custom views via `behaviors.getCustomDateFunc` returning `CellUnit.Week`, `Month`, `Quarter` or `Year`, plus `nonAgendaQuarterCellHeaderFormat` (#138).
- `CellUnit` typings now list `Week`, `Month`, `Year` and `Quarter`.
- New examples: Grouped Header, Weekly / Monthly Columns, and a rewritten Customization example. Example pages use antd modals instead of browser popups.

### Fixes and docs
- Per-instance locale (#146).
- Custom event popovers apply in every view, not only the agenda (#60); clicking an empty area no longer throws (#139).
- Verified on Next.js 15 + React 19 (#190, #225) and with state held in functional components (#191).
- README: custom resource cells (#148), `SchedulerData` with React state (#191), antd `ConfigProvider` theming (#113), vertical view, drop preview, cadence, and a supported-versions section.

### Previous releases
7.0.0 made the scheduler fill its parent container (responsive width, `className` / `style`), added the vertical resource view with drag-to-create across resources, and moved to React 19 / antd 6.
